transfer-peel-temperature: Specifies the recommended temperature state (hot, warm, or cold) at which the carrier sheet should be removed after pressing.
transposition-modes: Specifies the transposition/concert-pitch modes the tuner supports (e.g., concert pitch and transposing keys such as B♭ or E♭).
travel-spinning-wheel-assembly-required: Whether the wheel requires assembly/setup beyond unfolding (e.g., attaching flyer, tension, treadles) before use.
travel-spinning-wheel-portability-featur: Portability-related design elements for travel spinning wheels, such as folding construction and included transport solutions.
trigger-input-connector: Specifies the physical connector standard used for trigger inputs.
trigger-input-connector-type: Specifies the physical connector type used for trigger inputs.
trigger-input-zone-support: Indicates whether trigger inputs support single-zone and/or dual-zone triggers (e.g., head/rim) and similar multi-zone implementations.
trim-application-method: Indicates how the trim is intended to be attached to a project (e.g., sew-on, iron-on, adhesive).
trim-elasticity: Indicates whether the ric-rac trim has stretch for use on knit/activewear applications.
trim-finish: Surface finish treatment applied to the trim (e.g., metallic, glitter, reflective).
trophy-design: Describes the specific style or shape of a trophy, such as a cup or star
trumpet-bell-material: Material used for the bell section (sometimes differs from the rest of the instrument).
trumpet-leadpipe-material: Material or treatment used for the leadpipe (main pipe from mouthpiece to valves).
tuba-leadpipe-material: Identifies the material used for the leadpipe (mouthpipe) section of the tuba.
tube-base-type: Specifies the tube’s base/socket family used for physical/electrical fit (e.g., Octal, Noval/9-pin).
tube-component: Specifies the type of tube in music amplifiers, e.g. case, stand
tube-configuration: Describes the arrangement of tubes in a musical instrument amplifier, like single tube or matched pair
tube-matching-grade: Indicates whether tubes are tested/matched as a set and the type of matching provided.
tubing-shape: Specifies the cross-sectional shape of the stand's support tubing.
tulip-type-flower-form: Specifies the horticultural type/flower form of the tulips in the bunch (e.g., single, double, parrot).
tuner-design: Describes the style of electronic tuners for musical instruments, like clip-on or pedal
tuner-input-method: Specifies how the tuner detects pitch (microphone, vibration/clip sensor, instrument cable input, contact pickup).
tuning-mechanism: How the bongo heads are tensioned/tuned.
tuning-modes: Identifies the specific instrument settings for electronic tuners, like guitar or violin
tuning-pitch: Specifies the tuning pitch of an instrument, such as C# or Ab
tuning-range: Specifies the range of tuning options available, like standard or open
tuning-system: How the goblet drum is tuned or whether it is tunable.
twill-direction: Indicates the twill line direction of a denim weave.
twist-direction: Direction of ply twist used in the yarn/thread (S-twist or Z-twist).
uilleann-pipes-bag-material: Material of the air bag component (if included), which impacts feel, durability, and maintenance.
uilleann-pipes-handedness: Indicates whether the set is configured for right-handed or left-handed playing layout.
uilleann-pipes-set-configuration: Specifies what configuration of uilleann pipes is included, based on the presence of regulators and drones.
ukulele-back-and-sides-wood: Identifies the wood/material used for the ukulele back and sides.
ukulele-body-cutaway: Indicates whether the concert ukulele body has a cutaway for easier upper-fret access.
ukulele-body-shape: General body style/shape used for the ukulele.
ukulele-bridge-material: Specifies the material used for the ukulele bridge.
ukulele-construction-type: How the instrument’s top/back/sides are constructed (solid vs laminate).
ukulele-electronics-configuration: Indicates whether the ukulele is acoustic-only or includes onboard electronics (pickup and/or preamp) for amplification.
ukulele-string-re-entrant-tuning: Whether the ukulele is set up with re-entrant tuning (high-G) versus linear/low-G; common buyer preference and affects sound.
ukulele-top-wood: Identifies the wood/material used for the ukulele top/soundboard.
ukulele-tuner-mechanism: Specifies the tuner style/mechanism used on the ukulele.
ukulele-tuner-type: Style of tuning machine used on the ukulele headstock.
ukulele-tuning: Specifies the intended standard tuning for the pocket ukulele.
upholstery-material: Identifies the fabric used for upholstery, such as leather or velvet
upright-bass-pickup-system: Indicates whether the upright bass includes an installed pickup/preamp system intended for amplification.
upright-piano-power-source: How the upright piano is powered, applicable to acoustic uprights with no power as well as uprights with silent/hybrid systems requiring electricity.
usage-type: Specifies the product's intended use cycle, e.g. reusable, refillable
valve-configuration: Defines the functional style of the garden hose valve, helping buyers quickly select the correct solution for their watering setup.
valve-guard-coverage-area: Indicates which parts of the valve section the guard protects.
varnish-formulation-base: Specifies the primary formulation/chemistry of the string-instrument varnish, which affects appearance, reversibility, and compatibility with existing finishes.
varnish-transparency-tint: Describes whether the varnish is clear or tinted and, if tinted, the general tint family.
vegetable-matter-vm-content: Amount of plant debris/impurities present in the fiber.
vellum-opacity-level: Indicates how translucent or opaque the vellum sheet is.
vibraphone-bar-material: Material of the vibraphone tone bars/keys (the sound-producing bars).
vibraphone-motor-type: Type of motor used to drive the rotating resonator fans for vibrato (if equipped).
vibraphone-range-octaves: The vibraphone's pitch range expressed in octaves (e.g., 3 octaves, 3.5 octaves).
vibraphone-resonator-tube-material: Material of the vibraphone resonator tubes under the bars.
vibraphone-tuning-standard: Reference pitch used for tuning (A=440 Hz, etc.).
vintage-advertisement-decade: Specifies the decade the advertisement was originally printed or produced (approximate if exact year is unknown).
vintage-advertisement-format: Specifies the physical format or medium of the vintage advertisement collectible.
vintage-advertisement-subject-category: Identifies the product/service category being advertised (what the ad is for).
virtual-analog-synthesizer-form-factor: Specifies the physical format of the synthesizer chassis (keyboard vs module/rack).
viscosity-thickness: Describes how thick or fluid the slip is as sold or at recommended working consistency.
visual-effect: Defines the visual characteristics of a product, typically for art glazes; e.g. speckled, textured
wall-decal-style: Specifies how the decal is produced/applied (e.g., die-cut, transfer, sticker sheet).
warp-beam-type: Specifies the loom’s included or installed warp beam configuration (the beam setup provided with the loom).
washability: Indicates whether the glue cleans up with water and/or is washable after application.
water-resistance-level: Indicates whether the textile repels water and at what level.
water-resistance-rating-case-protection-: Indicates the level of water resistance/protection provided by the rolling case (marketing-level, not electronics IP sealing), e.g., water-resistant vs waterproof.
water-rocket-kit-items-included: Major included components in the product package.
water-rocket-propulsion-type: Primary propulsion/energy source used to launch the rocket.
Water + compressed air + parachute recovery (kit focus)
water-rocket-recovery-system: Method used to recover the rocket after launch.
watercolor-ink-water-resistance-after-dr: Indicates whether the watercolor ink becomes water-resistant/waterproof after drying (per manufacturer claim).
wax-blend-composition: Lists the wax materials blended in the product and/or the marketed blend type.
wax-physical-form: Indicates the physical form/shape the raw candle wax is supplied in.
wax-recommended-candle-application: Indicates the primary candle style(s) the wax is formulated for.
wax-type: Specifies the type of wax in items like candles, such as soy or paraffin
weave-type: Identifies the fabric weave/construction style (trade weave name) that influences texture, sheen, and drape.
weaving-beater-edge-type: Describes the working edge profile of the flat beater that contacts the weft (e.g., straight vs serrated).
weaving-beater-style: Identifies the functional style/format of the flat weaving beater.
weaving-shuttle-tip-style: Specifies the front tip/nose design of the shuttle, which affects how it passes through the shed and the likelihood of catching warp threads.
weaving-shuttle-use-case: Specifies the intended weaving application the shuttle is designed or optimized for.
weight-type: Describes the weight of items, such as light, medium, or heavy
wheel-arrangement: Specifies the steam locomotive wheel arrangement (Whyte notation), which is a defining characteristic and common collector/search term.
wheel-type: Specifies the kind of wheel for cycling products, such as inflatable or solid
whistle-head-material: Specifies the material of the whistle head/mouthpiece (fipple block/head).
whistle-light-features: Indicates whether the whistle includes integrated light effects for parties (e.g., LED).
whistle-sound-style: Describes the style/character of the whistle sound output (e.g., single-tone vs multi-tone).
white-glue-finish-appearance-when-dry: Specifies how the glue looks after drying for craft/office use (e.g., clear vs opaque).
white-glue-washability: Indicates whether dried glue can be washed out/cleaned from fabrics or skin.
whorl-mounting-interface: How the whorl attaches to the spinning wheel (shaft style/connection).
wick-construction-type: The construction/style of the wick (braided, flat, square braid, cored, wooden, etc.).
wick-core-type: Whether the wick is coreless or includes a core material (e.g., paper-cored or zinc-cored) affecting rigidity and burn characteristics.
wick-tab-crimp-type: How the wick tab secures the wick (construction/crimp style).
wick-tab-material: Material of the attached tab/sustainer (commonly tinplate), relevant for corrosion resistance and regulatory preferences (e.g., avoiding lead).
wick-tab-shape: Shape/form factor of the wick tab plate.
wick-type-included: Specifies the wick material/type included in the kit.
winder-features: Describes special characteristics of guitar string winders, like a bridge pin puller or built-in cutter
winding-method: How the weft is intended to be wound/loaded for use in the shuttle.
winding-speed-control-type: Indicates the method used to control the winding speed during use.
winding-type: Specifies the winding construction of the bass strings (outer wrap profile).
wine-additive-type: Specifies what kind of red-wine-making product this is (ingredient, additive, yeast, fining agent, kit, etc.).
wine-making-ingredient-type: Specifies the functional ingredient category for consumable winemaking additives and ingredients.
wine-making-stage: Identifies which step of the winemaking process the product is intended for.
wine-sweetness: Helps to categorize wines by level of sweetness, e.g. dry, sweet
winemaking-process-stage: Indicates the primary stage of the winemaking process the supply is intended for.
wire-coating-material: Specifies the outer coating/jacket material applied to the wire (not the core wire material), which can affect abrasion resistance and how smoothly it passes through bead holes.
wire-coating-type: Specifies whether and how the wire is coated/covered (for color, protection, and texture).
wire-construction-type: Specifies the physical construction of the beading wire, such as stranded vs solid and whether it is coated.
wire-finish: Specifies the surface finish, coating, or plating applied to the wire (e.g., polished, enameled, galvanized, plated), which affects appearance and tarnish/corrosion resistance.
wire-packaging-type: Specifies the way the wire is sold/packaged.
wire-rope-material: Specifies the material used in wire or rope products, like copper or polyester
wire-shape-profile: Describes the cross-sectional shape of the wire.
wire-thickness: Specifies the thickness of wires, like thick or fine
wood-block-surface-preparation: Indicates the ready-to-use surface state of the wood block for finishing and crafting.
wood-finish: Describes the finishing treatment or construction method applied to wood products (e.g., solid wood, veneered, engineered, oiled, lacquered, painted)
wood-grain-direction: Direction of the wood grain relative to the product’s longest dimension (important for strength, cutting behavior, and appearance).
wood-slice-edge-style: Edge condition of the slice, such as natural bark edge vs. smooth/sanded edge.
woodwind-body-construction: Indicates whether the instrument is made in one piece or multiple sections (e.g., 2-piece/3-piece), affecting cleaning, storage, and portability.
woodwind-care-items-included: Identifies the care items included with a woodwind instrument, such as cleaning brush or cork grease
woodwind-polishing-cloth-intended-use: Specifies what the cloth is primarily designed to clean/polish on a woodwind instrument.
woodwind-small-part-type: Specifies what kind of clarinet small replacement part the item is (e.g., keywork hardware, pads/cork/felts, rings).
worn-on-finger: Specifies which finger the thimble guide is intended to be worn on.
wrapping-occasion: Primary gifting/celebration occasion the wrapping paper is intended for.
wrapping-paper-features: Functional and sustainability-related properties of wrapping paper, such as tear resistance, recycled content, or pre-cut sheet formats.
wreath-design: Identifies the primary material or shape of a wreath, such as metal or hoop
xylophone-range-octaves: The xylophone's total range expressed in octaves (e.g., 2.5 octaves, 3 octaves, 4 octaves).
xylophone-resonator-type: Type of resonator system used to amplify tone (if any).
yarn-cutter-physical-style: Identifies the physical style of a yarn cutter (e.g., pendant, ring, snips) to support browsing and filtering within this category.
yarn-guide-style: The physical style of the yarn guiding component.
yarn-swift-adjustability: Indicates whether and how the swift can be adjusted (expandable, collapsible/foldable), affecting storage and the range of skein sizes it can handle.
yarn-swift-bearing-type: Describes the rotation support mechanism (e.g., ball bearing) that affects smoothness and winding speed.
yarn-weight-category: Identifies the thickness of yarn, like super bulky or craft
zill-playing-style: Intended playing context/style (commonly belly dance vs orchestral/cultural variants).
zill-strap-material: Material of the finger strap/elastic used to hold the zills (if included), impacting comfort, durability, and grip.
zills-strap-adjustability: Whether and how the included strap/elastic can be adjusted for fit.
zipper-application: Specifies the intended project or application the zipper is designed for.
zipper-chain-type: Specifies the construction/type of the zipper chain/teeth.
zipper-end-type: Indicates how the zipper terminates and whether it separates (open-end) or is closed-end (non-separating), including common separating-end hardware used in craft zippers.
zipper-gauge: Indicates the zipper chain gauge/size designation, typically expressed as a number with a # (for example, #3 or #5), which correlates to tooth/coil width and intended use.
zipper-pull-material: Specifies the material of the zipper pull or pull tab (the part you grip), distinct from the zipper teeth/chain and tape.
zipper-pull-side: Specifies which side(s) of the zipper the pull tab is accessible from.
zipper-pull-strap-cord-tab-material: Material of the strap/cord/tab/tassel component attached to the zipper pull (if present), excluding the main zipper pull hardware/body.
zipper-pull-style: Describes the design or finish on a zipper pull, such as textured or embossed
zipper-reversibility-mechanism: Specifies how the zipper is reversible (e.g., double-sided slider vs flip/auto-lock slider designed for reversible garments).
zipper-separating-type: Indicates whether the zipper separates at the bottom/top or is closed-end, for fit with jackets, sleeping bags, bags, etc.
zipper-slider-material: Specifies the material of the zipper slider (the moving mechanism), which can impact strength and corrosion resistance.
zipper-slider-pull-configuration: Indicates whether the zipper has one slider/pull or two, and whether pulls are on one or both sides of the slider.
zipper-tape-material: Specifies the primary material of the zipper tape (fabric sides) that is sewn into the project.
zipper-teeth-type: Specifies the construction style of the zipper chain/teeth (e.g., coil, molded plastic, metal, invisible), which affects flexibility, strength, and typical applications.
